claims.text: The ledger migration should be rolled back if settlement differences exceed five basis points.

supports.quote: Roll back the ledger migration if settlement differences exceed five basis points.
The September rehearsal used a ten-basis-point threshold; it is superseded by the October five-basis-point rule.

claims.text: The chosen shadow-table approach allows rollback without blocking existing writes.

supports.quote: Ledger migration chose a shadow table to allow rollback without blocking existing writes.
